name: Command palette
looksLike: search box floating over the page for actions
type a command to find something to do
popup list of commands filtered as I type
definition: A searchable panel for finding and running application actions or navigating to destinations without browsing menus.

notConfusedWith.difference: Chooses a field value; a command palette runs actions or opens destinations.

prompts.short: Add a command palette that filters actions as I type and closes with Escape.
prompts.detailed: Add a labeled dialog containing a search field and filtered command buttons. Keep focus inside while open, support keyboard access to results, close on Escape or selection, and return focus to the trigger. Include a close button and a clear no-results message. Do not override browser keyboard shortcuts.

reactTailwind: export function CommandPalette({ onAction }: { onAction: (id: string) => void }) {
<button type="button" className="min-h-11 min-w-11 px-3" onClick={() => { setQuery(""); dialog.current?.showModal(); }}>Open commands</button>
<dialog ref={dialog} aria-labelledby={titleId} className="m-auto w-full max-w-md rounded-xl p-4 backdrop:bg-black/40">
<input id={searchId} type="search" value={query} onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)} className="min-h-11 w-full border p-2" />
<button type="button" className="min-h-11 w-full p-2 text-left" onClick={() => { dialog.current?.close(); onAction(item.id); }}>{item.label}</button>
<button type="button" className="min-h-11 min-w-11 px-3" onClick={() => dialog.current?.close()}>Close</button>
